data.name: Beach Friends
data.detailed_description:
A social sandbox where players hang out on a shared tropical beach island full of chaotic minigames and activities.

Hang out around the beach and everything is interactable and every sand grain is simulated (not really, you wish).

And before you mention it, no there won’t be fishing. Nothing personal, I just hate fishing. Ok fine, it’s personal.

But there will be metal detectors. So you can go around, and uh, you know, metal detect. on the beach. to find coins. or gold. or bags of cash. to get rich. obviously.

Features

  • It's basically like summer vacation but you don't have to physically go to the beach

  • Hang out with your friends, or complete strangers

  • Proximity voice chat (but don't forget what mom said about talking to strangers)

  • Build sand castles, ruin your friend's sand castles

  • Do a bunch of random stuff (throw sand balls at each other, surf, sell ice cream, eat icecream)

  • Yes there will be volleyball (but with absolutely terrible physics)

  • Yes you can bury your friends in the sand (but they might fall under the map)

  • Yes there will be crabs that steal your money, and seagulls that swoop down to steal your ice cream.

  • No there won't be fishing.
